sermon.title: One Reason There is Suffering in the Earth Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: National choices bring suffering: court decisions, child abuse, incurable diseases, abortion, broken promises and municipal bankruptcies. The remedy is to follow Daniel—pray, worship, study the word and speak with courage.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

Jack Scap, age 54, pastor, husband, and father of 15,000 member First Baptist Church in Hammond, Indiana, just got fired last month for having sex with a 16-year-old girl. And there’s some sources say there’s 25, some sources say there’s 35, and some says there’s close to 40 different sexually transmitted diseases. Now, not just the syphilis and ganorrhea we had in the 60, 1960, but when the sexual revolution came, new sexual diseases were created. Syphilis, AIDS, warts, herpes, hepatitis, pelvic inflammatory disease, PID, and gorrhea. Five of these have no cure.

Five of these that cause death have no cure. The United States Department of Education said last year that 10% of public school children have been sexually abused by school employees or teachers, Department of Education. Think how much they’re hiding. They all lie. Did you get that? The Department of Education admits that one out of 10 kids have been sexually abused by school employees. And yet we send our kids there. In 2012, just this year, and just this week, a new Gallup poll shows that 78% of Americans rate education in private schools excellent.

78% 37% of Americans rate public schools as excellent. One in three. And yet they force us to send our kids to public school. These schools also teach evolution which removes God. Homosexuality. Bible is a myth. Jesus is just a man. Add that to the church problem. Ministers sexually abusing children and members. Members are sexually wild in the church. Why? Because there’s no Bible standard being preached constantly all the time. We’re into the second coming and possibility thinking and worship. Oh, give me music, man.

Give me music. Worship hasn’t changed the thing in America. I’m sorry you people that are so into worship and praise and Christian music. What has it done? You add the school problem to the church family and community problem and our children are in trouble. And that’s not good because the Lord said he would not forgive the shedding of innocent blood. He doesn’t like it when people that are innocent get hurt. Alcohol, illegal drugs is destroying lives, families, job production, and costing billions per year in taxes to correct the problem. They want free health to correct their problem. And that includes mental health.
